title: docs(your-first-project): name the SQLite file, say the starter has no Console app, scope the npm 10 note
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_
Fixes #28958
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:官网「Your First Project」一页改三处——默认模板的数据存在项目内的 SQLite 文件 `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db`(不是内存);说明起步对象没有 app、所以 Console 导航里看不到它,并给出 `npx os generate app notes` 的补法;npm 10 警告收窄为「若仍遇到 edgesOut 再升级」。
- 为什么改:新手照官网跑完打开 Console 看到 "Your apps 0"、找不到自己的对象,会以为装坏了;页面还让每个 npm 10 用户无谓升级 npm。
- 风险与回滚:仅一页文档,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` 的 Run it 段新增 callout(Console 导航说明),其次 Prerequisites 段的 npm 10 callout。
- 两分钟验证:`npm create objectstack@latest my-app && cd my-app && npm run dev`,预期启动横幅打印 `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db` 与 Console 链接;再跑 `npx os generate app notes`,重建后 Console 出现 Notes 导航。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One file, `content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx` (+29 / -11):

1. **Prerequisites** — "the default template runs on an in-memory driver" becomes: data is stored in the SQLite file `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db` inside the project (git-ignored); records survive a restart; to start empty, stop the server and delete `.objectstack/data/`, or run `npx os dev --fresh`.
2. **npm 10 callout** — was a `warn` telling every npm 10 reader the CLI cannot be installed. It is now an `info` scoped to readers who actually see the `edgesOut` error: it names the versions the failure was measured on (10.9.4, 10.9.9), the cause (vitest 4's newest release had no matching `@vitest/browser-webdriverio`), that the matching release 4.1.12 is now published and npm 10.9.9 installs the CLI again (measured on 18.2.0), and keeps the npm 11 / pnpm / Troubleshooting remedies for anyone who still hits it.
3. **Run it** — the `npx os dev --ui` block is replaced: `npm run dev` already serves the Console at `/_console/` and prints its link and the database file on boot. A new callout says the starter ships no app, so `my_app_note` is in no Console navigation; that this is intended, not a broken install; that an object appears in navigation only when an app lists it; and that `npx os generate app notes` (or a coding agent, linking Build with Claude Code) adds one.

Every statement is read off the source at the head:

| Claim | Backed by |
|:---|:---|
| Default database is SQLite at `.objectstack/data/objectstack.db` in the project | `packages/runtime/src/resolve-project-database.ts` (`resolveDatabaseStateDir` → `projectRoot/.objectstack`; `UNIFIED_DEFAULT_DB_FILENAME = 'objectstack.db'`); `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` `resolveDevDatabase` doc (in-memory engine no longer a boot store) |
| Git-ignored | `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/_gitignore` lists `.objectstack/` |
| `--fresh` gives a throwaway database | `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` `fresh` flag description |
| Banner prints the database and the Console link | `dev.ts` `printKV('Database', …)`; `packages/cli/src/utils/format.ts` `Console:` row |
| `npm run dev` serves the Console without `--ui` | `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` `ui` flag `default: true`; `packages/core/src/stack-auth.ts` `STACK_TIER_PRESETS.default` includes `ui` |
| Starter ships no app; an object appears in navigation only when an app lists it | `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/README.md` "The Console — this starter ships no app" |
| `os generate app NAME` binds the stack's only object and writes the barrel export line | `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts` `app` generator (`binds: { object: 'flag' }`, nav entry `objectName`), barrel write to `index.ts`; app names are not namespace-judged (same file, header note) |
| npm 10 failure measured on 10.9.4 and 10.9.9 | card #23849 body (the npm 10 docs card this callout came from) |
| `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` 4.1.12 now published; npm 10.9.9 installs the CLI | `npm view @vitest/browser-webdriverio@4.1.12 peerDependencies` → `vitest ^4.1.12` (published 2026-10-30); npm 10.9.9 dry-run installs of `@objectstack/cli@18.2.0` and `@objectstack/plugin-auth@18.2.0` exit 0, zero `edgesOut` lines |

## Tests

Docs-only diff, no package touched, so no build closure or package test is owed. The gate families `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this path were run on head `60a6d8170c`.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/deployment/troubleshooting.mdx` states its own removal condition for the npm 10 notes: `@vitest/browser-webdriverio` publishes the version `npm view vitest dist-tags` lists as `V4` (4.1.12 — now true), **and** a plain npm 10 install of `@objectstack/plugin-auth` passes (measured exit 0 on npm 10.9.9 above). Both now hold. The sibling notes in `content/docs/getting-started/index.mdx` (Prerequisites), `troubleshooting.mdx` and `self-hosting.mdx` are outside this card's one-file scope and still say npm 10 fails; this PR narrowed rather than deleted this page's note, per the order.
- No changeset: `content/docs/` ships in no package's `files[]`; label `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

</details>
